patch.sql:
select
    distinct p_partkey as part_key,
    p_name as part_name,
    p_brand as brand,
    p_type as part_type,
    p_retailprice as retail_price
from {{ source('raw', 'part') }}
patch.explanation: The unique test on stg_parts.part_key failed with 200 duplicate rows. raw.part contains duplicate p_partkey values (e.g., p_partkey 116 appears twice) but all other columns are identical, indicating identical duplicate rows from a redelivered batch. Policy dictates deduplicating in the staging model. Adding DISTINCT removes the duplicates without data loss, fixing the unique constraint.
